one_line: Frontier commander of the Bengal Sultanate and patron of Kavindra Parameshwar’s Bengali Mahabharata on the Chittagong frontier, c. 1515–1525 CE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, athletic and solid build, veteran soldier’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Bengali complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard, sharp attentive eyes with a calm authoritative default expression.
appearance.hair: Short, straight black hair kept tidy under a deep green quilted Muslim-style turban with a folded tail at the back and a simple brass turban ornament at the front.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved, knee-length cotton jama (fitted upper garment) in muted ivory with fine vertical pale-gold stripes, he wears a dark emerald-green quilted cotton coat (khil‘at-style) with side slits and a cloth belt in maroon wrapped twice at the waist; loose straight trousers in deep brown tuck into simple leather riding boots in dark tan; a narrow maroon sash hangs from the belt, and a modest brass signet ring and small hoop earrings add frontier-elite detail.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved cavalry sabre with a plain brass hilt and dark leather scabbard, worn at his left hip and often resting in his right hand in a relaxed but ready grip.

ref_desc: Paragal Khan is a mid-40s medium-brown oval-faced commander with a short black beard, deep green turban, ivory striped jama, emerald quilted coat, maroon belt and sash, brown trousers, tan boots, and a brass-hilted sabre in a dark leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style historical character of Paragal Khan as a dignified early-16th-century Bengal Sultanate frontier commander: mid-40s, medium-brown oval face, straight nose, sharp eyes, short black hair under a deep emerald-green quilted turban with a simple brass ornament, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, wearing an ivory knee-length jama with fine pale-gold vertical stripes beneath a dark emerald-green quilted cotton coat with side slits, secured by a maroon cloth belt wrapped twice at the waist and a hanging maroon sash; he has loose straight dark-brown trousers tucked into sturdy dark-tan leather riding boots, a modest brass signet ring and small hoop earrings, and carries a slightly curved cavalry sabre with a plain brass hilt in a dark leather scabbard at his left hip, all in a palette of emerald green, ivory, maroon, dark brown and brass, shown clearly from head to toe for consistent redrawing.
